english.note: Use this when evidence or an idea is challenged so that people doubt its truth or reliability.
Use this when you call the truth, validity, or legitimacy of something into question rather than simply oppose it.
Use this when challenging the truth, accuracy, or validity of a claim.
Use this, especially in formal or written contexts, when actively challenging a claim or assertion rather than merely doubting it.
Use this when openly challenging or calling an assertion, decision, or authority into doubt.

examples.english: Some people discredit this theory by questioning its credibility.
examples.traditional: 有人質疑呢個理論嘅可信性。
